account_token.description: The account token associated with the card being tokenized.

card_token.description: The card token associated with the card being tokenized.

created_at.description: Date and time when the tokenization first occurred. UTC time zone.

device_id.description: The device identifier associated with the tokenization.

digital_card_art_token.description: Specifies the digital card art displayed in the user's digital wallet after tokenization. This will be null if the tokenization was created without an associated digital card art. See [Flexible Card Art Guide](https://docs.lithic.com/docs/about-digital-wallets#flexible-card-art).

events.description: A list of events related to the tokenization.

status.description: The status of the tokenization request

token.description: Globally unique identifier for a Tokenization

token_requestor_name.description: The entity that requested the tokenization. For digital wallets, this will be one of the defined wallet types. For merchant tokenizations, this will be a free-form merchant name string.

token_unique_reference.description: The network's unique reference for the tokenization.

dpan.description: The dynamic pan assigned to the token by the network.

payment_account_reference_id.description: The network's unique reference for the card that is tokenized.

tokenization_channel.description: The channel through which the tokenization was made.

updated_at.description: Latest date and time when the tokenization was updated. UTC time zone.
